delivery.outcome: Koru defines the governed ignore and reproducibility boundary needed to move generated analysis, coverage, tree and media output out of Git.
nonGoals: Delete project governance scripts, ticket history or ticket indexes
Rewrite Git history or delete remote artifacts
Change runtime behavior or dependency manifests
Delete generated files owned by a dependent integration delivery
Modify documentation or CI paths owned by other workstreams

architecture.decision: Treat bulky analysis, coverage, tree and media files as reproducible external artifacts while retaining governance carriers and one compact hash/version registry in Git.
architecture.rollback: Revert the protected merge to restore the exact generated baseline; removed files remain recoverable from acceptedBaseSha without rewriting history.

validation.evidence: local deterministic gate output and protected checks
